description:
Ethereum mainnet ERC-20 allowance a holder granted a spender. Ethereum mainnet ERC-20 allowance. Takes query parameters token (ERC-20 contract, 0x + 40 hex), owner (0x + 40 hex) and spender (0x + 40 hex). Returns the raw allowance read from the contract.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_eth_reads_v1/eth_mainnet_erc20_allowance. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
Measured output: {"chain": "ethereum", "method": "allowance", "ok": true, "result": "0", "service": "x402_eth_reads_v1.eth_mainnet_erc20_allowance"}
name: x402_eth_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_erc20_allowance
